d: Bernie Sanders and Democratic Senator Elissa Slotkin have joined forces to demand a change in Senate Democratic leadership, openly challenging Chuck Schumer's bid for re-election. Sanders says he will not support Schumer, arguing that Democrats need a bold new direction after their sweeping midterm victory. Slotkin is also withholding her support, demanding a concrete plan for the first 100 days, a new approach to governing and stronger communication with voters.
